title: 第4181章 临行前的安排第4180章 学会等待
content_zh:
黑夜。
寒风凛冽。
遍地狼藉的李园中，一众宾客相继离去，惊世一战后，只留下满目疮痍，触目惊心。
一众人族强者离去时，脸上明显有着几分留恋和不舍，因为近距离和道门圣贤接触的机会可不多，错过就不再来。
而在人族强者们离开后，妖祖皇崖天也带着七杀星等妖族大将走了，虽然妖族和人族有着上千年的恩怨，而妖祖，又有神明这一身份，不过，太商还是没有为难这些妖族强者。
也许，今日之后，妖族和人族依旧会争斗，甚至，会打的你死我活，但是，今日李子夜大婚，妖族的表现，并未丢九州的脸，在对抗外敌一事上，表现得非常果断。
所以，尚且需要留着力气前往南天门那边的太商，对于如今的妖族领兵者，选择了网开一面。
当然，让太商不愿浪费力气在妖族之上的另一个原因就是，妖族如今也有着自己的麻烦，无需他浪费力气去对付。
前院中，水镜、孤峤还有玄风三位妖族神境强者看着妖祖等人离开，由于神女不在，暂时选择了隐忍，没有出手阻止。
夜色下，随着各方强者相继离开，李园，也渐渐变得安静下来，不再像先前那般吵杂。
李园的下人们相继从其他各院走出，待看到前院那方圆百丈的巨坑和周围千疮百孔的景象后，全都有些茫然不知所措。
相较神境武者的飞天遁地、举手投足间毁天灭地之能，普通人对于武道的认知终究有限，如今，亲眼见识到武者之战的可怕，心中不禁生出了几分恐惧。
“慢慢收拾，不着急。”
李子夜看出下人们的震惊，神色平和地宽慰道，“辛苦各位了。”
前院中，一众下人听到小公子之言，相继回过神来，朝着眼前小公子行了一礼后，开始着实收拾残局。
“四公主。”
不远处，朱珠迈步走到了红拂身前，伸手摘下了头上的凤冠，主动送还，轻声道，“多谢。”
“李夫人客气。”
红拂接过凤冠，目光看着眼前女子，神色复杂地说道，“有一事，我需要提醒夫人一声，你压制在心脉中的那些赤雷，一定要多当心，赤雷虽然有再生之力，却也有很强的毁灭之力，谨之慎之！”
“四公主的提醒，妾身记下了。”朱珠点头应道。

十步外，李子夜看到朱珠将凤冠还回，却也没有多说什么。
“就这么还回去了？”
意识海中，凤凰眼见朱珠主动还回了凤冠，有些不甘心地说道，“其实，我们可以趁着人多，做掉这位四公主，将凤冠彻底据为己有。”
“做人要有诚信。”
李子夜神色平静地应道，“一顶凤冠而已，不可惜，不属于自己的神器，拿到手，用着也不心安。”
“……”
凤凰听到某人言不由衷的回答，心中无语。
心安？
这个词从这小子口中说出，怎么这么别扭。
content_en:
dark night.
The cold wind is biting.
In the messy Li Garden, all the guests left one after another. After the shocking battle, only the devastation was left, which was shocking.
When a group of powerful human beings left, there was obviously a bit of nostalgia and reluctance on their faces, because there were not many opportunities to have close contact with Taoist sages, and if you missed it, you wouldn't come back again.
After the strong men of the human race left, the demon ancestor Huang Yatian also left with Qishaixing and other demon generals. Although the demon clan and the human race had thousands of years of grudges, and the demon ancestor had the status of a god, Taishang still did not embarrass these powerful demon clans.
Maybe, after today, the demon clan and the human clan will still fight, and even fight to the death. However, today, Li Ziye's wedding, the demon clan's performance did not disgrace Jiuzhou, and showed very decisiveness in fighting against foreign enemies.
Therefore, Taishang, who still needed to save his energy to go to Nantianmen, chose to be open-minded towards the current leader of the demon clan.
Of course, another reason why Taishang doesn't want to waste his energy on the demon clan is that the demon clan now has its own troubles, and he doesn't need to waste his energy to deal with them.
In the front yard, Shui Jing, Gu Qiao, and Xuan Feng, three strong men in the divine realm of the demon clan, watched the demon ancestor and others leave. Since the goddess was not around, they chose to endure it for the time being and did not take action to stop them.
Under the night, as the powerful people from all sides left one after another, Li Yuan gradually became quieter and no longer as noisy as before.
Li Yuan's servants walked out of other courtyards one after another. When they saw the huge pit with a radius of 100 feet in the front yard and the scenes full of holes all around, they were all at a loss.
Compared with the ability of divine warriors to fly to the sky and escape from the earth, and to destroy heaven and earth with every move of their hands, ordinary people's knowledge of martial arts is limited. Now, seeing the horror of warriors' battles with their own eyes, they can't help but feel a little fear in their hearts.
"Take it easy, don't rush."
Li Ziye saw people's shock and calmly comforted him, "Thank you for your hard work."
In the front yard, all the servants came to their senses one after another after hearing what the young master said. After bowing to the young master in front of them, they began to clean up the mess.
"Fourth Princess."
Not far away, Zhu Zhu walked up to Hong Fu, reached out and took off the phoenix crown on her head, took the initiative to return it, and said softly, "Thank you very much."
"Mrs. Li, you're welcome."
Hongfu took the phoenix crown, looked at the woman in front of him, and said with a complex expression, "There is one thing, I need to remind my wife, you must be more careful with the red thunder that you suppress in your heart. Although the red thunder has the power of regeneration, it also has a strong power of destruction, so be careful!"
"I have taken note of the Fourth Princess's reminder." Zhu Zhu nodded in response.
Ten steps away, Li Ziye saw Zhu Zhu returning the phoenix crown, but said nothing more.
"Just return it like this?"
In the sea of consciousness, Fenghuang saw Zhu Zhu take the initiative to return the phoenix crown, and said with some reluctance, "Actually, we can take advantage of the crowd to kill the fourth princess and completely take the phoenix crown as our own."
“You must have integrity as a person.”
Li Ziye responded calmly, "It's just a phoenix crown. It's a pity that if you get a divine weapon that doesn't belong to you, you won't feel safe using it."
"..."
Phoenix was speechless when he heard someone's insincere answer.
Peace of mind?
Why is it so awkward to say this word from this kid's mouth?
